tool.name: sincei scScoreFeatures
tool.description: aggregate region-level signal into gene or feature scores
tool.command: #if $features.is_of_type('gtf'): ln -s '$features' features.gtf && #set $features_file = 'features.gtf' #else: ln -s '$features' features.bed && #set $features_file = 'features.bed' #end if scScoreFeatures --input '$input' --features '$features_file' --outFile scores.h5ad --overlapPolicy '$overlapPolicy' --maxRegion $maxRegion $centerScores $normalizeGeneLengths #if str($bedScoreFilter).strip(): --bedScoreFilter $bedScoreFilter #end if @THREADS@ && mv scores.h5ad '$scores'

param.label: Features
param.help: BED or GTF file containing the features to use for aggregation/scoring.

param.label: Overlap policy
param.help: Policy for handling regions present in the input AnnData that only partially overlap the features.
param.option: partial: count reads in AnnData regions proportionally to the overlap fraction
all: count all reads in the partially overlapping AnnData regions
none: only count reads in AnnData regions fully contained within the features

param.label: Maximum region (kb)
param.help: Maximum region size (in kb) upstream and downstream of the genes to consider for activity calculation.

param.label: Center scores
param.help: If set, center and scale the scores to unit variance and zero mean.

param.label: Normalize gene lengths
param.help: Whether to apply length normalization to the input genes. If set, gene scores are normalized w.r.t. gene length in the input GTF/BED file.

param.label: BED score filter
param.help: Provide a range (two values separated by space), or a threshold (upper limit) of score to determine which input features to consider for scoring. Used only when the input is a BED file containing scores (stored in the 5th column).

validator.message: One or two numbers separated by a space

tool.help:
**What it does**
`scScoreFeatures` sums the signal of a binned count matrix (e.g. from `scCountReads bins`) over genes or other features from a BED/GTF file. The result is a cells x features score matrix, for example gene activity scores from scATAC or scChIP data.
-----
**Inputs**
- An AnnData (`h5ad`) count matrix with genomic regions as variables. - A BED or GTF file of features.
**Outputs**
- An AnnData (`h5ad`) object with one score per cell and feature. @HELP_FOOTER@
